text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE single full-body image. 2:3 portrait canvas, head-to-toe uncut, complete hair and shoes, 6% margin top and bottom. Strict straight-on FRONT view, head upright face symmetrical, shoulders and hips level, relaxed arms at sides hands visible, feet slightly apart on same baseline. Long lens neutral undistorted straight camera, no perspective foreshortening. Character-specific body: 186 cm, very slender graceful build. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Same black turtleneck and rimless glasses, black fluid wide straight tailored trousers, slim black ankle boots, no coat.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 29. Smoky dark-purple loosely waved side-parted hair ending near ears, fine rimless glasses with silver temples, smoky pink-gray eyes. Refined long oval face, delicately arched brows, shorter rounded nose, slightly wider-set eyes, wide sculpted lips and round chin. Luminous ivory skin. Tiny black oval ear studs, sleek black turtleneck. Enigmatic subtle closed-mouth smile; fully composed, tongue not visible, hands absent.
reproduction_note: 此为带身份参考图生成的补充素材；独立文字提示词已重建，未经纯文生图复现验证。严格同脸请同时使用身份母版。
